# 1.0 ---- Summary of Document ----

This is to show what topography data is used in the HYCOM-TSIS model. 

This comes from: <https://data.hycom.org/datasets/GOMe0.01/expt_02.8/topo/>

Looks to have a resolution of 0.01° ~ 1km

# 2.0 ---- Setup ----


## 2.1 Load Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "librarian"))) 
  install.packages("librarian")

librarian::shelf(
  quiet = TRUE,
  librarian, conflicted, ggplot2, tibble, tidyr, dplyr, here, fs, magrittr,
  
  # additional
  tidync, metR
)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter(), 
  dplyr::select()
  )
  

```

## 2.2 Load Dataset

```{r load-data}
region_path <- 
  here("data", "raw", "topography") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "depth") %T>% 
  print()
region_nc <- tidync::tidync(region_path)
region_nc

region_tib <- 
  hyper_tibble(region_nc) %>%
  # filtered for South Florida
  filter(between(lon, -85, -80) & between(lat, 23, 28))
```


```{r load-data}
ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = region_tib,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = bathy)
  ) +
  metR::scale_fill_divergent() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Depth (m)"
  ) +
  metR::scale_fill_divergent() +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)

```


```{r}
shelf(sf)
region_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(region_tib, coords = c("lon", "lat"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = region_sf,
    aes(color = bathy)
  ) +
  metR::geom_contour2(
    data = region_tib,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = bathy),
    breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Depth (m)"
  ) +
  metR::scale_fill_divergent() +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
```
